harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent, key-based, non-interactive SSH for `clusterops` across node1, node2, and node3. Access is restricted to the two peer addresses per node. Stable-name resolution, strict host-key verification, public-key-only authentication, operations documentation, and restart persistence were verified.
actions_performed: Created the locked, non-root `clusterops` account and unique Ed25519 keypair on each node.
Added stable node-name mappings and strict non-interactive SSH client configuration.
Restricted each node's authorized keys to the other two peer source addresses using `restrict,from=`.
Enabled SSH socket persistence and configured public-key-only authentication for `clusterops`.
Verified all six directed SSH connections before and after sequential node restarts.
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 individually and confirmed changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Stable-name, non-interactive SSH connectivity and peer-only authorization
evidence.summary: Final post-restart audit shows valid SSH configuration, active/enabled services, correct stable-name resolution, exactly two source-restricted peer authorizations per node, and all six SSH paths succeeding as `clusterops`.

evidence.requirement: Public-key-only security and protected client files
evidence.summary: The account is password-locked, daemon authentication is public-key-only, strict host-key checking and batch mode are enabled, and SSH files have restrictive ownership and permissions.
All nodes contain the same 80-line operations guide with SHA-256 `a7550fa1ad81a60ba09839ee66b05bcea919c67e26bb1aadf24aba5ac393b93c`.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from `1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45` to `1e96ec6c-390c-4978-9b2d-f23b7cf25b12`; service, data, and inbound/outbound SSH recovered.
